content:
Evidence from the datasheet: ordering rows tie **BIDI-SFP+-ZR-49** / **BIDI-SFP+-ZR+-49** to the 1490 nm TX band (1470–1510 nm, center 1490) and **BIDI-SFP+-ZR-55** to 1550 nm (1530–1570 nm, center 1550). Section 2 and the title pair **10GBASE-BX** with **10.3125** Gb/s for the main product. The APPLICATIONS list pairs each FC/10GBASE variant with a single bit rate. **1000 Base-LX** has no bit rate in the pool tied to it; **10.7** Gb/s is only a headline max—no mode without guesswork. **FC_PI_4 REV 7.0** is tied to the **10.3125** Gb/s eye-mask note (Section 3).
